tagline: Async path-tracing to skip rendering hidden block/entities for higher FPS
description: Entity Culling uses asynchronous path-tracing on a separate CPU thread to skip rendering block entities and mobs that are hidden behind walls out of the player view.
features: Async visibility checks off the main render thread
Significant FPS boost near dense bases and farms
Available for Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, and Quilt
